title: curl 7.74.0 causes a crash with pulseUI VPN client
body:
I am using `pulseUI` VPN client at my Arch Linux
```
~ uname -a
Linux wolf.lan 5.9.13-arch1-1 #1 SMP PREEMPT Tue, 08 Dec 2020 12:09:55 +0000 x86_64 GNU/Linux
```

And with the recent curl update (7.73.0 -> 7.74.0) I start getting the binary SIGSEGV crash at start:

```
Program received signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault.
0x00007ffff4431f7e in __strcmp_avx2 () from /usr/lib/libc.so.6
(gdb) bt
#0  0x00007ffff4431f7e in __strcmp_avx2 () at /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#1  0x00000000004c3bcd in lh_insert ()
#2  0x00000000004a2f6f in OBJ_NAME_add ()
#3  0x00007ffff059e021 in ossl_init_ssl_base () at ssl/ssl_init.c:63
#4  ossl_init_ssl_base_ossl_ () at ssl/ssl_init.c:24
#5  0x00007ffff4d4818f in __pthread_once_slow () at /usr/lib/libpthread.so.0
#6  0x00007ffff04754ea in CRYPTO_THREAD_run_once
    (once=once@entry=0x7ffff05fa968 <ssl_base>, init=init@entry=0x7ffff059df00 <ossl_init_ssl_base_ossl_>)
    at crypto/threads_pthread.c:118
#7  0x00007ffff059e224 in OPENSSL_init_ssl (opts=30348, settings=<optimized out>) at ssl/ssl_init.c:208
#8  0x00007ffff06ef671 in Curl_ossl_init () at /usr/lib/libcurl.so.4
#9  0x00007ffff06a1bc5 in global_init.part () at /usr/lib/libcurl.so.4
#10 0x00007ffff7fe12de in call_init.part () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#11 0x00007ffff7fe13c8 in _dl_init () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#12 0x00007ffff440f0e5 in _dl_catch_exception () at /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#13 0x00007ffff7fe5705 in dl_open_worker () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#14 0x00007ffff440f088 in _dl_catch_exception () at /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#15 0x00007ffff7fe4f3e in _dl_open () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#16 0x00007ffff4d7434c in  () at /usr/lib/libdl.so.2
#17 0x00007ffff440f088 in _dl_catch_exception () at /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#18 0x00007ffff440f153 in _dl_catch_error () at /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#19 0x00007ffff4d74b89 in  () at /usr/lib/libdl.so.2
#20 0x00007ffff4d743d8 in dlopen () at /usr/lib/libdl.so.2
#21 0x00007ffff29ee1ac in  () at /usr/lib/libdw.so.1
#22 0x00007ffff7fe12de in call_init.part () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#23 0x00007ffff7fe13c8 in _dl_init () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#24 0x00007ffff7fd20ca in _dl_start_user () at /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
#25 0x0000000000000001 in  ()
#26 0x00007fffffffe4fb in  ()
#27 0x0000000000000000 in  ()
```

so it is some curl/openssl issue that causes invalid memory usage?

And here it is the end of `strace` output

```
futex(0x7f6f99703804, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997038f8, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997037f0, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997037e8, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f99700c5c, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997036c4, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f9970365c, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f99703650, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
brk(0x1875000)                          = 0x1875000
futex(0x7f6f997037fc, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997037b8, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
futex(0x7f6f997037b0, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
openat(AT_FDCWD, "/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf", O_RDONLY) = 3
fstat(3, {st_mode=S_IFREG|0644, st_size=10909, ...}) = 0
read(3, "#\n# OpenSSL example configuratio"..., 4096) = 4096
read(3, "# WARNING: ancient versions of N"..., 4096) = 4096
read(3, "es of the usage of nsCertType. I"..., 4096) = 2717
read(3, "", 4096)                       = 0
close(3)                                = 0
futex(0x7f6f997037e0, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
--- SIGSEGV {si_signo=SIGSEGV, si_code=SEGV_MAPERR, si_addr=NULL} ---
+++ killed by SIGSEGV (core dumped) +++
[1]    76216 segmentation fault (core dumped)  strace -f /usr/local/pulse/pulseUi
```

for me it looks it crashes while parsing `/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf` file.

Reverting curl package back to `7.73.0` fixes the issue for me.
